title: THE COMPACT SMG NO LONGER BUILDS INTO A HEAVY SHAKE
why: His Q5: gun feel. The Compact SMG fires every 88 ms and each round set a 2.2 kick: 0.157 trauma a round against 0.123 that drains between rounds, so a held magazine climbed round after round into a big screen shake. 2.2 to 1.9 cuts the worst shake of a held magazine from 4.65 px to 1.4 px and keeps a light buzz.
now: The Compact SMG now shakes the screen lightly and evenly while you hold the trigger.

edits.replacement: var GUN_SHAKE={shotgun:6.5,smg:1.9};   // v28.xx (cw-kicksmg): the Compact SMG 2.2 to 1.9, so a held magazine no longer climbs into a heavy shake (88 ms between rounds: 2.2 adds 0.157 trauma a round and 0.123 drains; measured worst shake of a full held magazine 4.65 px at 2.2, 1.41 px at 1.9)
